title: The TTYH3/MK5 Positive Feedback Loop regulates Tumor Progression via GSK3-beta/beta-catenin signaling in HCC.
authors: Wang, Yixiu; Xie, Yuwei; Dong, Bingzi; Xue, Weijie; Chen, Shuhai; Mitsuo, Shimada; Zou, Hao; Feng, Yujie; Ma, Kai; Dong, Qian; Cao, Jingyu; Zhu, Chengzhan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TTYH3/MK5正反馈环路经GSK3-beta/beta-catenin信号调控肝癌进展，虽涉及蛋白互作但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the leading causes of cancer-related death worldwide, and identification of novel targets is necessary for its diagnosis and treatment. This study aimed to investigate the biological function and clinical significance of tweety homolog 3 (TTYH3) in HCC. TTYH3 overexpression promoted cell proliferation, migration, and invasion and inhibited HCCM3 and Hep3B cell apoptosis. TTYH3 promoted tumor formation and metastasis in vivo. TTYH3 upregulated calcium influx and intracellular chloride concentration, thereby promoting cellular migration and regulating epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related protein expression. The interaction between TTYH3 and MK5 was identified through co-immunoprecipitation assays and protein docking. TTYH3 promoted the expression of MK5, which then activated the GSK3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway. MK5 knockdown attenuated the activation of GSK3beta/beta-catenin signaling by TTYH3. TTYH3 expression was regulated in a positive feedback manner. In clinical HCC samples, TTYH3 was upregulated in the HCC tissues compared to nontumor tissues. Furthermore, high TTYH3 expression was significantly correlated with poor patient survival. The CpG islands were hypomethylated in the promoter region of TTYH3 in HCC tissues. In conclusion, we identified TTYH3 regulates tumor development and progression via MK5/GSK3-beta/beta-catenin signaling in HCC and promotes itself expression in a positive feedback loop.
abstract_zh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，识别新的靶点对其诊断和治疗至关重要。本研究旨在探讨tweety homolog 3（TTYH3）在HCC中的生物学功能及临床意义。TTYH3过表达促进了细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，并抑制了HCCM3和Hep3B细胞的凋亡。TTYH3在体内促进了肿瘤形成和转移。TTYH3上调了钙内流和细胞内氯离子浓度，从而促进细胞迁移并调节上皮-间质转化相关蛋白的表达。通过免疫共沉淀实验和蛋白质对接，鉴定了TTYH3与MK5之间的相互作用。TTYH3促进了MK5的表达，后者随后激活了GSK3beta/beta-catenin信号通路。MK5敲低减弱了TTYH3对GSK3beta/beta-catenin信号的激活。TTYH3的表达以正反馈方式受到调控。在临床HCC样本中，与非肿瘤组织相比，HCC组织中TTYH3表达上调。此外，高TTYH3表达与患者生存期较差显著相关。在HCC组织中，TTYH3启动子区域的CpG岛呈低甲基化状态。总之，我们确定了TTYH3通过MK5/GSK3-beta/beta-catenin信号在HCC中调节肿瘤发展和进展，并通过正反馈环促进其自身表达。
